title: PancakeSwap Bot Sniper - Front Running on PancakeSwap [UPDATED]
description: FOR EDUCATION PURPOSES ONLY  In this video, I show you how to build a simple pancakeswap bot for front running with Solidity that automatically locates any liquidity to a BSC token and immediately executes a transaction. The sale is automatically triggered at a profit when a token's liquidity is fully collected into your wallet.  NOTE: The current parameters of this contract are that 10% of the profit is automatically returned to the front-run pool and 90% of the profit will be automatically sent back into your wallet.  The remaining pool will be fruther used for front-running for profit until you use transaction "Action" function in Remix again.  NOTE: Token to select is Binance Smart Chain. It will utilize the WBNB Pancakeswap router.   UPDATE: One disclaimer I may have missed is to recommend minimum 0.2 BNB.   I have received messages from people who didn't have enough funds to cover gas fees and possible burn fees. The bot targets token contracts with maximum 10% burn fee and anything below that. Gas fees average 0.006*2 (0.012 BNB). Better if there is no burn. If it targets tokens with 10% burn, that's another 0.04 BNB subtracted from the 0.2BNB. Most tokens these days have some burn. With less than 0.2BNB, you don't have much to do.  Get MetaMask:  https://metamask.io/download.html  Connect MetaMask to Binance Smart Chain:  https://academy.binance.com/en/articl...  Access Remix: https://remix.ethereum.org/  Paste SmartContract in Remix:  https://github.com/BSCNODE/FrontrunDe... annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes a contract that supposedly automatically buys and sells through PancakeSwap to generate profits, instructing viewers to activate it by transferring BNB and authorizing wallet transactions. It claims potential returns of up to 100 BNB per day and advises adding more funds, despite noting an educational disclaimer and lacking independent verification of the bot's operation or profits.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: A front-running bot is linked to deployment, funding, wallet authorization, automated PancakeSwap trading and claimed returns. The speaker explicitly instructs viewers to send funds to the contract and describes adding more funds as increasing potential earnings. The content explicitly presents front-running retail investors as the mechanism for obtaining trading profit. This describes the stated market-manipulation mechanism and does not establish that it successfully worked.
